notes: Reconciled. Blind labelers A and B agree on 1 bend, [1,4], with no override. I checked independently and found nothing to change. The part is an L-angle: 1.95 mm sheet, a flat plate about 177 x 38.6 mm (u -87.5..90.6) with 2 round holes, a small end protrusion, a diagonal corner cut and a narrower end tab (u 69..90.6). It has one ~90 deg return flange along the long edge, ~9.7 mm deep (outer). Perpendicular sections at u = -85.3 .. 68 all show the same rounded 90 deg L-profile. The arc sweeps the full 0..90 deg from u -86.1 to 68.7 and ends at the plate end face and at the relief notch before the flat end tab. Sections at u 69.5 .. 80 are flat plate only. Residual maps of the plate skins (both) and the outer flange skin are within about +-0.05 mm, with smooth gradients and no kink lines. Across-width slope is under 0.12 deg, so there is no joggle, hem or small-angle bend. Patches 2/3 are the inner-skin twins of the same fold, and [2,4] / [1,3] are mixed-skin duplicates, so the fold is marked once, on the outer skin. Real scan: open mesh, ragged edges and stray points.

bends.note: Single ~90 deg press-brake fold along the long edge. Outer skin: 1 = outer face of the plate, 4 = outer face of the return flange. The fold arc runs u -86.1..68.7 in the part frame (~154.8 mm), from the plate end face to the relief notch before the flat end tab. The flange free edge is cut diagonally near u 64..68.5. The auto clip (coverage 1.0) reaches within ~0.4 mm of both ends, so no override is needed.
